name: MapKit map with places
description: A SwiftUI Map showing places as markers with selection and standard controls; no location permission needed.
usage: Model places as `MapPlace(id:name:latitude:longitude:)`. Show `PlacesMap(places:selection:)` with a `@State var selection: MapPlace.ID?`; react to selection (for example show a sheet). Use placeholder coordinates for sample data. For the user's own location add the location-services capability.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify mapkit-map` on a Mac.
